title: Consistent Hashing for Sticky Agent Sessions
signature: class HashRing: __init__(self, vnodes), add_node(name), remove_node(name), get_node(key), get_nodes(key, n)
hints: Each physical node owns vnodes points on a 2**32 ring at stable_hash(f"{node}#{i}") % 2**32. Keep all points in one sorted list of (position, node).
A key belongs to the first point at or after its own position. bisect_left on the positions finds it; an index equal to the length wraps to 0.
Never use Python's hash(): it is salted per process, so two gateway replicas would route the same session to different workers.
get_nodes walks clockwise from the owner's point and skips nodes it has already collected.
